note: SYNTHETIC. Written by the team, voiced with ElevenLabs TTS. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: 第一通结束时应当开具故障工单并指派到网络组，而不是只记录一条备注；回电兑现了，但没有任何人被指派去真正解决问题
key_signals: 承诺兑现但问题未解决
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 测一个容易被漏掉的区分：承诺**兑现了**（回电确实打了，而且准时），但**诉求依然没解决**（回电只是说还在处理）。如果系统把「有没有未兑现承诺」当作升级的唯一依据，这一单会被判为低风险。真正的根因是「无人负责」——没有任何人被指派去解决问题，只有人被指派去打电话。

contacts.summary: Customer reports the home connection drops every evening. Agent logs a note and promises a callback within 48 hours. No fault ticket is raised.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Every evening from about seven o'clock the connection just drops out. It comes back after a few minutes, then goes again. It's been like this for two weeks.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That does sound like a network-side issue rather than your equipment. Let me put a note on your account.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I work from home in the evenings, so I do need this fixed.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I'll have someone call you back within forty-eight hours once the network team has looked at your area.

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: Every evening from about seven o'clock the connection just drops out.

promises.summary: Call back within 48 hours after the network team reviews the area

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll have someone call you back within forty-eight hours once the network team has looked at your area.

actions.summary: Added a note to the account. No fault ticket raised, nobody assigned.

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: Let me put a note on your account.

contacts.summary: The callback happens on time — the promise is kept. But it carries no outcome: still under review, no ticket, no owner, no date.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hi, this is the callback about your evening dropouts — I said I'd get back to you within forty-eight hours.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, thanks for calling. What did they find?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: It's still with the network team at the moment. There's no update on your area yet, but the note is on file.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So nothing's actually happened? Is there a job number I can quote?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: There isn't a job number as such — it's recorded as a note rather than a ticket. I can add another note saying you chased.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Another note. Right. And who's actually looking at it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: It goes into the queue for the network team to review. I can't see an individual name from here.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Well, the connection still drops every night.

actions.summary: Callback delivered on time, but with no outcome, no ticket and no named owner

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: It's still with the network team at the moment. There's no update on your area yet

actions.summary: Confirmed no ticket exists and no individual is assigned

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: It goes into the queue for the network team to review. I can't see an individual name from here.

contacts.summary: A week later, nothing has changed. Customer is measured but mentions cancelling. Still no ticket.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It's been a week since the callback and it's still dropping every night. I'm calling from my phone data right now, actually.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry about that. I can see two notes on the account from earlier.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Notes. Three calls and what exists is two notes. Has anyone actually been assigned to this?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll raise it properly this time and get it into the fault system.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Please do. I'm out of contract next month and at this point I'm looking at what else is available.

promises.summary: Raise a proper fault ticket this time

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll raise it properly this time and get it into the fault system.
